popCulture.title: Epigoni
popCulture.description: Aegialeus, son of Adrastus, dies in the Epigoni's second Theban war — the only one of the sons to fall, closing Adrastus' house.

popCulture.title: Aegialeus
popCulture.description: Disambiguation hub for the Argive Epigonus and other Aegialeuses — pin the Adrastid, not the Sicyonian king.
